root.name: English Opening: Neo-Catalan Declined
root.moves: 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 d5 4. Bg2 Be7

overview: Black keeps the d5 pawn and plays ...Be7 and ...O-O, leading to a Closed Catalan after O-O and d4. White presses on the long diagonal with the g2 bishop and the queenside, while Black builds a solid position and aims for ...dxc4 and ...c5 or ...b6 counterplay. Play is slow and positional.

white_ideas.idea: Castle, play d4 and Qc2, keeping the long-diagonal pressure on d5 and b7.
Press on the queenside with Nbd2/Nc3 and a later cxd5 or Qa4.

black_ideas.idea: Castle, play ...c6 or ...dxc4 and solid development, then free the position with ...c5 or ...e5.
Neutralise the fianchetto bishop with ...c6 and ...Nbd7 and aim for ...b6 and ...Bb7.

typical_structures.structure: Closed Catalan with d4/c4 against d5/e6, centre in tension and White's long-diagonal bishop.

character.notes: Black's set-up is solid and hard to break down; White has pressure but few direct threats.

structure.notes: Centre in tension with d4/c4 against d5; not locked.

approach.notes: A standard Catalan move order played by strong players.

level.notes: Needs positional understanding; little forced memory.

character.reason: Closed Catalan set-up is hard to break down.

plans.reason: White's long-diagonal bishop drives the plan.
